headline: Touchstone Partners advises Nium on acquisition of Cypher
detail: Nium Pte. Ltd. has acquired Cypherd Wallet Inc, a crypto-native non-custodial wallet and issuing company. Touchstone Partners advised Nium on the acquisition of Cynorage Software Private Limited, the Indian subsidiary of Cypher, on this transaction.
